aggregates.claim: A finite ledger over the exact current collected suite, with every execution ID, primary requirement, input/profile fingerprint, current adjudication, declared phase and evidence class bound into the inventory review. Inventory adjudication is distinct from case approval: explicit current needs-oracle or disputed members remain listed, unapproved and ineligible for qualified passes. Unreviewed, stale or falsely labelled reference evidence cannot be silently adopted. Declared-valid runtime effects, other effects, positive admission controls, undefined-result contexts and invalid-input diagnostics have separate populations. Actual observations are joined by exact ID and compiler configuration without adding an execution or attributing a canonical case to this requirement.
aggregates.limitation: Observational infrastructure only: S4.2-001's facet remains pending until the source/requirement census, complete conforming fixture/oracle inventory and separate processor/dependency qualifications are independently established. No finite run proves the universal processor obligation. A filtered invocation retains all unselected members in its denominator. XFAILs remain failures; skips, unsupported modes, missing profiles, unavailable launchers, unexecuted run effects and provisional observations cannot become qualified passes. A compile/link admission is not execution of an interpretation, and a context-only run is not an assertion about an undefined value. Resource failures do not establish permitted size/complexity limits. Compiler headers, companions, launchers and profile observations describe the selected interface, not ABI certification or universal portability. Paragraphs 7-8 are recommendations, not manufactured mandatory documentation requirements.

review.rationale: Explicit source-context renewal of the unchanged 2083-member inventory after the independently reviewed 10.2.3.1 and 10.2.3.2 masked array assignment source registration in doc/source_audits/batch_109.json. All 2083 case bindings, their fingerprints, 2047 raw reviews, 218 older catalogues, 22 links, R402 and the b153c75b baseline remain exact. Only 18 of the 30 scoped base units are newly accounted, because the twelve numbered items R1042 through R1050 and C1035 through C1037 are all in 10.2.3.1 and were already accounted while 10.2.3.2 contains none; the reviewer verified this by recomputing the suite accounting algorithm against the base commit rather than trusting the author. 75 new facets remain pending. The control mask and pending control mask semantics were independently derived from the source before comparison, covering eight transitions: top-level establishment, at-most-once mask evaluation, the masked ELSEWHERE sequence in which the control mask first becomes the previous pending mask, then pending becomes that mask conjoined with the negation of the new mask, then control becomes that mask conjoined with the new mask, the bare ELSEWHERE case, END WHERE restoration, and the crucial distinction that a nested WHERE construct alters the pending control mask while a nested WHERE statement does not. The catalogue states all eight directly from p1 through p8 and no requirement or facet relies on the subclause example as authority. Exactly one permission is recorded: p13 permits the execution of a function reference in the mask expression of a WHERE statement to affect entities in the assignment statement, expressly the statement rather than a construct statement or masked ELSEWHERE, and the catalogue keeps that scope. No local element-assignment-order latitude exists in 10.2.3, so per-element assignment order, snapshot and temporary issues correctly remain with the registered 10.2.1.3 rather than being demoted. Masking oracle discipline was verified: unselected elements are preloaded with values different from every right-hand-side value so the assertions cannot be vacuous, no plan computes expected masking with MERGE, PACK, COUNT or an equivalent intrinsic, the at-most-once facets carry no call-count oracle, and the unobservability limits are scoped to order, call counts, side effects, temporaries, short-circuiting and storage rather than suppressing directly observable branch membership. No masked assignment execution, canonical link or SourceUse observation is supplied, and no compiler was invoked. The eight substring executions integrated in batch099 remain the latest actual observations. All pending facets, unresolved units, the retained needs-oracle real-BOZ block and every global gate remain open.
